entries.subject: Jorda, Gaskell and Kaasalainen shape, PDS 2013, DOI 10.26007/55FK-CB77
entries.finding: [Jorda, Gaskell and Kaasalainen shape, PDS 2013](https://pdssbn.astro.umd.edu/holdings/ro-a-osinac_osiwac-5-steins-shape-v1.0/dataset.shtml), DOI 10.26007/55FK-CB77 — **Included**. `steins_cart.wrl` has 10,242 vertices and 20,480 triangles in km. The wrapped VRML is parsed directly; source axes, connectivity and physical scale are preserved before meshoptimizer simplification.

entries.subject: Stooke Small Bodies Maps V3
entries.finding: [Stooke Small Bodies Maps V3](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds3/multi_mission/MULTI_SA_MULTI_6_STOOKEMAPS_V3_0/document/00_map_guide.html) — **Included** Monochrome. Unannotated 3600×1800 cylindrical map, controlled by Leyrat2010. Higher-resolution visualization compilation than the referenced original figure, but heavily processed and not calibrated reflectance. The gridded and named companions establish the projection and remain reference documents.

entries.subject: OSIRIS photographic lens registration
entries.finding: The calibrated NAC/WAC release and native labels were examined. The README’s older source survey called the WAC view qualified, but its current Known problems records that neither former selected image has a surface-intercept anchor or fitted image-to-shape registration. The photographic lens is deferred. Camera/quaternion metadata and footprint agreement alone do not establish registration; the separately selected Stooke Monochrome map is unaffected.
entries.revisitWhen: Source-supported image-to-shape registration with independent withheld checks qualifies the actual frames, together with their quality masks and declared illumination treatment.

entries.subject: Rosetta NAC stray-light corrected reflectance and WAC counterparts
entries.finding: [Rosetta NAC stray-light corrected reflectance](https://pds.nasa.gov/ds-view/pds/viewDataset.jsp?dsid=RO-A-OSINAC-4-AST1-STEINS-STR-REFL-V1.0) and WAC counterparts — **Deferred** with the camera-data route above. Their calibrated products address stray light/distortion, not the per-surface incidence/emission normalization required for a global albedo lens. Catalog availability is not evidence that a ready registered map exists.
entries.revisitWhen: A reusable product with the required camera or map registration, quantity definition and validity information; qualify it against the selected body model before promotion.

entries.subject: Leyrat et al. 2010 and Schröder et al. 2010
entries.finding: [Leyrat et al. 2010](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pss.2010.04.003) and [Schröder et al. 2010](https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.00184) — **Excluded as texture inputs**. These studies provide photometric/variegation interpretations, and Leyrat controls the selected released map. The bounded archive/citation survey found the registered Stooke release and calibrated mission images; it did not locate an independently released, unannotated global corrected-albedo raster. This remains an unresolved dataset candidate, not a claim no such data exist.
entries.revisitWhen: A reusable product with the required camera or map registration, quantity definition and validity information; qualify it against the selected body model before promotion.

entries.subject: USGS/LPI cartography and IAU nomenclature
entries.finding: USGS/LPI cartography and IAU nomenclature — **Reference only**. Searches identified nomenclature and annotated image products, not a higher-resolution registered science raster for this package.

entries.subject: OSIRIS 18:37:16 and later follow-up frames
entries.finding: The 18:37:16 image required gain 1.56, above the retained 1.35 limit. The examined 18:37:56, 18:38:36 and 18:39:43 views had progressively poorer source/model footprint agreement. They remain excluded; the former Minnaert treatment is superseded.
entries.revisitWhen: Corrected source calibration or independently verified camera/model registration changes the failed result without raising acceptance limits.

entries.subject: Stooke mosaic coverage and coordinate limits
entries.finding: The retained registration note binds the east-positive map with 0° at its center and documents the half-turn conversion. Its edge-connected dark-pixel test marks 3,567,208 of 6,480,000 map pixels as exterior. This is a display heuristic, not a scientific validity mask or 55% physical-surface coverage. The original map lacks a verified source mask, and its registration to each vertex of the later shape is not bounded by that test.
entries.revisitWhen: A source validity mask or independent per-pixel coverage/registration reference can replace or qualify the documented heuristic.
